name: Cable Car
brief: a cabin hanging from a wheel hanger that rolls on a cable; windows on the sides; the hanger arm rises from the roof to the wheels

name: Ice Fishing Hut
brief: a small wooden hut on the ice with a pointed roof, a door at the front and a chimney pipe

name: Hover Polo Craft
brief: a flat round hover craft with a skirt, a seat in the middle and a fan box at the back
size: about 50 wide, 20 tall, 60 long; flies just above the ground

name: Sentry Drone
brief: a patrol robot: a ball body on a short neck over a wide base, one eye at the front

name: Dock Crane
brief: a crane: a square tower, a long arm pointing forward from the top, a cable and a hook hanging from the arm's end

name: Lighthouse
brief: a round tower getting narrower to the top, a lamp room with windows, and a pointed cap

name: Penguin
brief: a penguin: an egg body, a round head, a small beak at the front, two flippers, two feet

name: Robot Vacuum
brief: a flat round robot vacuum with a bumper at the front and a small light on top

name: Clock Gear
brief: a big flat gear wheel standing upright with 8 teeth and an axle through the middle
size: about 80 wide, 80 tall, 10 deep; flies (fixed to the wall)

name: Hot Air Balloon
brief: a round balloon on top, ropes down to a square basket, a burner between them

name: Train Engine
brief: a small steam engine: a long boiler on a frame, a cab at the back, a chimney at the front, four wheels

name: Two Key Door
brief: a door frame with a door panel inside it and a big coloured key shape above the frame
